primary_endpoint: Incidence of treatment-emergent adverse events (TEAEs) over 52 weeks.
efficacy_outcome: Versus placebo, resmetirom 80 mg and 100 mg reduced LDL-C by 11.1% and 12.6%, apoB by 15.6% and 18.0%, triglycerides by 15.4% and 20.4%, and hepatic fat at week 16 by 34.9% and 38.6% (P < 0.0001).
safety_signal: TEAEs occurred in 86.1% (100 mg), 88.4% (80 mg), 86.5% (open-label 100 mg), and 81.8% (placebo); diarrhea and nausea exceeded placebo at treatment initiation.
